views.purpose: The diagram presents the overall organization of the system by depicting main architectural components, their responsibilities, layered or subsystem decomposition, dependencies, and the structural separation and collaboration among user-facing functionality, application logic, domain entities, and data persistence.
required_evidence: modules or subsystems that own the task named by responsibility
containment or uses relations between layers, subsystems, user-facing functionality, application logic, domain entities, and data persistence
views.diagram_language_rule: viewpoint agent chose plantuml: PlantUML accurately structures the hierarchical modules, subsystems, layers, and their containment relationships as required by the questions.

notes: Eligible because they frame the chosen concerns: module-decomposition, context, cnc-runtime, code-mapping

Context was rejected because it only covers boundary systems and actors without showing internal layers, application logic, or domain entities; code-mapping was rejected because it deals with implementation types rather than high-level architectural components and subsystems; cnc-runtime was rejected because it focuses on runtime connectors rather than static module and layer decomposition.

diagram language plantuml: viewpoint agent chose plantuml: PlantUML accurately structures the hierarchical modules, subsystems, layers, and their containment relationships as required by the questions.
